work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief CXLI erects the Cape of Good Hope into a vicariate apostolic independent of the Mauritius vicar; heading on artifact page 219, body from the head of artifact page 220 (LF31022) after the edition’s note 2 and sheet number 27; LF31073 → LF31079 across running title LF31076; complete 6 June 1837 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF31022–31022; the source closing at LF31085–31088 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die sexta iunii millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo septimo, pontificatus Nostri anno septimo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
